title: Open questions
description: Judgement calls about where something is: what the map shows, the other reading and why. Each names the features concerned and the episode from which it may be shown.

first_seen.description: The earliest episode at which the question gives nothing away; no earlier than any of its features.

features.description: Ids of the story features the question concerns; empty when it concerns a place the map does not draw.

why.description: Why the map shows what it does.

detail.description: Optional. A few sentences more, with the numbers behind the call, folded on the card.

other_at.description: Optional. Where the other reading would put the feature: a ring the reader can show on the map.

evidence.description: Optional. Links to how the call was made: repository paths, opened on GitHub.
